SECTION: FLRS02 §3 + §4 — functional criterion, frozen before any lineage outcome

SOURCE_FUNCTION_ONSET.definition: the step at which a spatial centre first sustains a local X source, i.e. the centre carries at least one Y and a non-empty accepted-birth candidate pool
SOURCE_FUNCTION_ONSET.observable: ycells candY > 0 at a cell belonging to the centre
SOURCE_FUNCTION_ONSET.timescale: immediate — an event, not a relaxation

PROFILE_MATURATION.definition: the step at which the centre's local X cloud has relaxed to the chosen fraction f of the level it would sustain
PROFILE_MATURATION.observable: local X mass within CORE_R of the centre
PROFILE_MATURATION.governing_rate: muX, established as the slowest mode above

SPECTRUM_DEMONSTRATION.operator: n -> (1-muX) * Hop(n); Hop is the engine's four ordered sub-shifts, separable per axis
SPECTRUM_DEMONSTRATION.INTERPRETATION: every spatial mode decays strictly faster than the uniform population mode, so the long-time relaxation of ANY positive local X functional is governed by muX. The population e-folding is therefore the correct primary relaxation mode for the functional observable.

PRIMARY_FUNCTIONAL_CRITERION.justification: one e-folding of the slowest — and therefore governing — relaxation mode of the X field

MANDATORY_SENSITIVITY_BAND.purpose: determine whether the route decision depends critically on one arbitrary response fraction

H_HOLD_16.reason: it was the median of an observed S-run distribution, never a derived maturity requirement

X_BIRTHS_101.reason: the pre_removal_level of one OBTC02 arm, not a derived threshold

RETIRED_CRITERIA.REHABILITATION_RULE: neither may be reinstated because it yields a favourable historical outcome

STATES.C: multiple Y but one spatial centre

LINEAGE_EVENT_DEFINITION.CENTRE_RULE: toroidal single-linkage over Y-occupied cells with adjacency distance <= CORE_R (5.0)
LINEAGE_EVENT_DEFINITION.FOUNDER_IDENTITY: irrelevant — no genealogy is constructed or required
FUNCTIONAL_TWO_CENTRE_SUCCESS_REQUIRES_A: 1. at least one dynamic Y birth occurs
2. the lineage does not go extinct before functional maturation
3. exactly two spatial centres form under the frozen centre classifier
4. both centres remain spatially distinct for at least T(f) consecutive steps
5. both centres exhibit the required local X response
6. no third centre appears BEFORE the functional maturation event
7. X/source integrity remains acceptable until that event
EXPLICITLY_NOT_REQUIRED: survival of the original founder particle
old C1/C2/C3 formulas as substitutes for directly recorded events

UNIT: one world; steps and episodes are NEVER independent replicates
